title: Crash Course (Kanji)
description: 18th EMS from Kadena Airbase partners with the JASDF 9th Air Wing to learn how to use a disabled wheel dolly.
keywords: crash, Disabled, damaged, JASDF, Self, Marines, AIr Force, navy, base, army, Okinawa, Japan, partnership, Kadena, recovery, airfield, F-15, defense, PACAF, joint, Force, air, Pacific

transcript.text: - So today we wrapped up the
first joint United States Air Force
and Japan Air Assault Defense Force with JASDF,
crash damage and disabled aircraft recovery training event.
Today, we did debog, which is the more common aircraft
scenario you may run into, and then we went, also went
over how to use a disabled wheel dolly, commonly referred
to as a crash gate, so for some odd reason,
you can't use the aircraft wheel, the tire blew,
it's an assembly that negates the need
for the actual aircraft wheel.
(machine cranking)
The quicker we can get our airfield cleared,
well, the quicker the JASDF can get
their airfield cleared and restore normal operations, the
less detriment that ripples across all
of Japan, as far as diverting flights.
(equipment cranking)
So the goal is to show them what we can do well.
So that they can take those lessons back
and apply them at Naha and so we can also see
what they're doing well, so we can get better ourselves.
